name: MediaGrabber
description: MediaGrabber - Jellyfin Edition connects your Jellyfin dashboard directly to MediaGrabber. Paste single or bulk YouTube, YouTube Music, Spotify, Instagram, and TikTok links, pick Video or Audio format, monitor live download progress, cancel or retry jobs, and refresh Jellyfin libraries without leaving Jellyfin. Requires a download-scoped MediaGrabber API key.
overview: Queue YouTube, YT Music, Spotify & gallery downloads directly from Jellyfin into your MediaGrabber library.
